criteria.description: Uses the expected persistence label, or a clearly equivalent label, to reject a single-hour-burst summary.
criteria.name: Final consistency label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for identifying multi-day rainfall but giving an ambiguous or overly broad label.

criteria.description: Reports 133.3 mm total precipitation and 109.0 mm for the wettest 72-hour window.
criteria.name: Event total and window sum
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for one correct value, small rounding mistakes, or correct formulas with a minor extraction error.

criteria.description: Identifies the wettest 72-hour window as 2013-06-15T00:00 through 2013-06-17T23:00.
criteria.name: Window timing
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct three calendar days without exact hourly endpoints.

criteria.description: Gives ratios near 0.818 for the 72-hour share, 0.812 for wet-hour fraction, and 0.047 for peak-hour share.
criteria.name: Ratio calculations
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for two correct ratios, incorrect rounding, or one arithmetic mistake.

criteria.description: Computes the minimum 166.7 mm gap between the local event total and the report-extracted greater-than-300 mm heavy-rain reference.
criteria.name: Report-map threshold contrast
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recognizing the higher map reference but omitting or misrounding the gap.

criteria.description: Explains that high wet-hour and 72-hour shares, together with a small peak-hour share, support a persistence-dominated rainfall state.
criteria.name: Formula-linked interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct interpretation that cites only one ratio.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields without unrelated management guidance or broad causal narration.
criteria.name: Output discipline
criteria.partial_credit: No partial credit; award the point only when the output stays focused on the ledger.
